proposal.ruling_text: The build did not reach the item: the configured Claude Code subscription login again failed because its OAuth session had expired and could not be refreshed. Authentication failures are deliberately not classified as transient vendor-capacity failures, and this changes neither the specification nor the definition of done. Reauthenticate the operator’s Claude Code subscription session before trying again. Because build-01 and build-02 have the same non-null stop signature, the early-stop guard forbids an automatic third attempt; after reauthentication, resume explicitly with `attavo drive 267 --again --by LOGIN`.
